name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the instance. Valid values: PostPaid (pay-as-you-go) and PrePaid (subscription)
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The zone where the instance is deployed. This parameter is required for classic network-type dedicated instances. This parameter is optional for VPC-connected dedicated instances
parameters.help_zh: 可用区，专享实例类型为传统类型专享实例为必填项，VPC融合类型专享实例可以不填
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

If PricingCycle is set to Month, the valid values are 1 to 9.

If PricingCycle is set to Year, the valid values are 1 to 3.

This parameter is required and takes effect only if you set ChargeType to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
实例包年包月的时间，取值：

PricingCycle为Month，表示按月付费，取值范围为1~9。
PricingCycle为Year，表示按年付费，取值范围为1~3。

ChargeType取值为PrePaid时，本参数可用且必须传入
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle of the subscription instance. Valid values:

year

month

This parameter is required if you set ChargeType to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或包月类型，取值范围如下：

year：年
month：月

若付费类型为PrePaid，该参数为必传参数
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-payment for renewals. Valid values:

True: Auto-payment is enabled. Make sure that your account has a sufficient balance.

False: Manual payment is required. To pay for an order, log on to the console. In the upper-right corner, choose Billing > User Center. On the Order Management page, find the order and complete the payment.

Default value: False
parameters.help_zh:
续费时是否自动付费。取值：
True：自动付费。请确保账号有足够的余额。
False：控制台手动付费。具体操作为：登录控制台，在右上角选择费用>进入费用中心，在订单管理找到目标订单进行支付。

默认值：False
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: A security token used to prevent duplicate requests. Do not reuse the token. The gateway automatically removes leading and trailing spaces from the token string
parameters.help_zh: 口令，是用来做防止重复提交请求的，请勿重复使用。如果Token字符串的前后包含空格，空格会被网关自动删除（Trim）
parameters.name: token
